title: Own-model scope and voice
decision: Build and operate our own White Hmong / Hmong Daw / Hmoob Dawb TTS model with one clear, neutral voice for RPA lessons and everyday reading; hosted proprietary TTS and purchased vendor auditions are outside the execution path. Exact cloning of Jee or another narrator is not required.
rationale: Owner decision recorded in the controlling plan (R-04.1, R-06.8); defines the product and the data we control.

title: Model and platform selection
decision: Keep one bounded Magpie adaptation attempt and one compact single-speaker VITS fallback; select using measured Hmong evidence. F-01/F-04 close this decision.
rationale: Architecture success on the 5090 is unmeasured; the reference specification is 32 GB GDDR7 and compute capability 12.0, but fit and support must be proven by the F-04 gate.

title: Native roles and funding
decision: Native roles and paid quotes are not contracted; the implementation agent prepares scoped workload and price before any approval request.
rationale: Listener calibration, corpus QA and locked evaluation require human native work that an agent cannot supply or pay for.

title: Data and model rights
decision: Rights are source-specific and unresolved where undocumented; unresolved sources (including CMU and the unlabelled broadcast data) cannot feed training or weight distribution.
rationale: Access to a player, repository or API is not permission to train, publish weights or redistribute recordings (issue F-03).

title: Release quality and operations
decision: Keep intelligibility, lexical-fidelity, naturalness and stability release requirements with a calibrated scoring protocol; no automatic lower-quality tier. Deliver local synthesis and approved static lesson audio first; F-09 is Not required unless a concrete hosting requirement is authorized.
rationale: No candidate has been qualified; thresholds cannot be lowered and hosting is not mandatory for local/static delivery.

title: Isolate recovery work on a new branch
decision: Create feat/white-hmong-tts-recovery from origin/main 5919bb0650737a1534dc5746e191714820039b7d and keep all recovery commits there; do not alter the static book or publish branch.
rationale: The named branch did not exist and main was clean at the recorded SHA; the published book must stay untouched during research.

title: Artifact storage and Git boundaries
decision: Keep raw audio, derived data, checkpoints, run outputs and private records out of ordinary Git; commit manifests, configs, small reports and hashed evidence only. Reserve 100-200 GB plus an independent checksummed backup.
rationale: Large/private assets must not bloat public history; hashes keep external artifacts resolvable.

title: Selective reuse of the retired PR #1 archive
decision: Reuse the syllable inventory/orthography and non-destructive audio-audit design from archive commit 96698f0; do not reuse MLX code, syllable stitching, its split unit or its audio artifacts.
rationale: The inventory is documented repository knowledge; the MLX experiments are not a qualified 5090 environment and the stitching approach did not deliver accepted connected speech.

title: Package layout and separate environments
decision: Create src/rpa_tts/{text,data,training,inference,evaluation}/ with configs/tts, tests/tts and docs/tts/recovery; keep the TTS environment (uv, Python 3.12, PyTorch cu128) separate from the pinned Sphinx book environment.
rationale: The issue proposes these surfaces; separate environments prevent research pins from breaking the published build.

title: Normalization contract baseline rpa-norm-1
decision: Adopt lossless RPA normalization rpa-norm-1: NFC, recorded typographic mappings, whitespace collapse, lowercased model form, full tone/onset/vowel preservation, and explicit rejection of digits, foreign words and unsupported characters until a native-approved expansion table exists.
rationale: The contract must not silently apply English cleaning or guess number words; every transformation is recorded and raw text is retained.

title: No new recordings or worksheet from Jee
decision: Treat as a lasting constraint: Jee will not record new calibration audio, recruit a speaker, or complete the 272-row native worksheet. Remove that expectation. F-02 remains blocked unless a permitted existing corpus plus an independent native reviewer is secured, or an explicit scope change is adopted.
rationale: Recording capacity is unavailable; pretending otherwise would produce fictional gate evidence. Acceptance criteria are unchanged.

title: Existing-source-only acquisition with corrected mww identity
decision: Use existing White Hmong sentence audio only; no new recordings. Correct the CMU lookup to ISO mww and fileset MWWHDVN2DA. Treat the CMU index and FCBH Hmong Daw New Testament as the same source. Do not reconstruct or train until training/derivative rights and audio access are granted.
rationale: Owner correction and the CMU LangList row/filenames identify mww/MWWHDVN2DA; FCBH terms grant personal use only and the DBP API requires a key, so no permitted audio exists yet.

title: Research milestone using existing paired recordings is not adopted
decision: The owner is considering a narrower research milestone built from existing paired recordings, but it has not been adopted. Until an explicit written scope decision names the data, permitted uses and research questions, keep the original F-07 product criteria and do not relabel a research result as the accepted product.
rationale: A scope change needs explicit adoption; silent substitution would violate the issue acceptance criteria and rights/native gates.
